content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Technical Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICAR IARI Technical Assistant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Technical Assistant: Graduate degree in Agricultural Sciences, Biological Sciences or a relevant discipline. Desirable: Work experience in pathogen isolation, molecular work, fungicide/pesticide applications etc.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: For all posts, the minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 45 years. Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST and women, 3 years for OBC. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute Regional Station (ICAR IARI).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Technical Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Technical Assistant post is scheduled for 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Graduate degree in Agricultural Sciences, Biological Sciences, or a relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying to the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Technical Assistant post is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Technical Assistant post will receive a salary of Rs. 15000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the ICAR IARI Technical Assistant Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Technical Assistant post involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
